title: 第九章 大成剑意第十章 崇明公主
slug: 震惊我的徒弟居然是女帝
content_zh:
白少华嘴角微微上扬，一剑斩去，顿时平地起风。
天阶上品剑技，狂风剑！
一道肉眼可见的风刃，蕴含着肆虐的剑意，向燕青丝袭来。
燕青丝脸色一变，使出了她最强的一招天阶上品剑技。
剑舞长空！
轰！
对碰之下，燕青丝的漫天剑影瞬间瓦解。
同时。
她整个人连退十几步，嘴角溢出一丝鲜血。
“这就是剑意的威力？”
“这还怎么打？”围观弟子惊叹道。
莫问天知道在让燕青丝战斗下去已经没意义。
“青丝认输吧！”莫问天劝道。
“不，我想在试试。”
燕青丝的执着让莫问天有些懵。
最后他顺着燕青丝的眼神看向了秦天。
“真是男颜祸水，孽缘啊。”
“你快认输，难道你连师傅的话都不听了吗？”莫问天继续劝道。
他知道继续下去，燕青丝肯定会身受重伤的。
燕青丝依旧不为所动。

白少华冷笑一声，又一剑挥去。
燕青丝再次被击退。
“还挺有骨气的，竟然这样你就别怪我辣手摧花了。”
话落，他在次使用剑意。
狂风剑！
又一道蕴含剑意的风刃袭来。
轰！
她直接被劈飞了出去，胳膊上也留下一道剑痕。
秦天有些看不下去，直接一个起跳接住了燕青丝。
两人缓缓落下。
“哇！太帅了！”
“要是我受伤了，小师叔会不会也抱我！”一旁女弟子羡慕的说道。
此时秦天怀中的燕青丝已经羞红了脸。
秦天拿出一枚地阶极品丹药塞入她的嘴里，伤势一下就稳住了。
伤口也开始慢慢愈合。
“臭小子，你还要抱多久？”莫问天看到自家小白菜被秦天抱着，有些不悦了。
听到莫问天的话，燕青丝连忙从秦天怀中跑了出来。
秦天看向了安妙菱，淡淡的说道，“去吧！解决他我还要回去喂鱼呢。”
“嗯！”
安妙菱在众人惊讶的目光中走上前去。

在他们印象中，安妙菱虽然是个绝世天才。
但是也才入门十来年，年纪也要比他们小个七八岁。
所以他们不太看好安妙菱。
她没有理会众人的目光，缓缓抬起纤纤玉手。
content_en:
The corners of Bai Shaohua's mouth raised slightly, and he slashed with his sword, causing a sudden wind to rise from the ground.
Heaven-level top-grade sword skill, Wild Wind Sword!
A wind blade visible to the naked eye, containing raging sword intent, attacked Yan Qingsi.
Yan Qingsi's expression changed, and she used her strongest heaven-level sword skill.
Swords dance across the sky!
boom!
Under the collision, Yan Qingsi's sword shadow instantly disintegrated.
at the same time.
She took a dozen steps back, and a trace of blood spilled from the corner of her mouth.
"Is this the power of the sword?"
"How can we fight like this?" the onlookers exclaimed.
Mo Wentian knew that there was no point in letting Yan Qingsi continue to fight.
"Qingsi, give up!" Mo Wentian advised.
"No, I want to give it a try."
Yan Qingsi's persistence made Mo Wentian a little confused.
Finally, he followed Yan Qingsi's eyes and looked at Qin Tian.
"It's really a curse for men to be handsome, such a bad fate."
"You are about to give up. Don't you even listen to the master?" Mo Wentian continued to persuade.
He knew that if he continued, Yan Qingsi would definitely be seriously injured.
Yan Qingsi remained unmoved.
Bai Shaohua sneered and swung his sword away again.
Yan Qingsi was repelled again.
"You're quite brave. Don't blame me for being so cruel."
As soon as he finished speaking, he used his sword intent again.
Storm Sword!
Another wind blade containing sword intent struck.
boom!
She was thrown straight away, leaving a sword mark on her arm.
Qin Tian couldn't stand it anymore and jumped up to catch Yan Qingsi.
The two fell slowly.
"Wow! So handsome!"
"If I get hurt, will my junior master hug me too!" A female disciple on the side said enviously.
At this time, Yan Qingsi, who was in Qin Tian's arms, was already blushing with embarrassment.
Qin Tian took out a top-grade elixir and stuffed it into her mouth, and the injury was stabilized instantly.
The wound also began to heal slowly.
"You brat, how much longer are you going to hold me?" Mo Wentian was a little unhappy when he saw his little cabbage being held by Qin Tian.
After hearing Mo Wentian's words, Yan Qingsi quickly ran out of Qin Tian's arms.
Qin Tian looked at An Miaoling and said calmly, "Go! After finishing him, I have to go back to feed the fish."
"Yeah!"
An Miaoling stepped forward amidst everyone's surprised gazes.
In their impression, An Miaoling was a peerless genius.
But he has only started working for about ten years, and he is seven or eight years younger than them.
So they are not very optimistic about An Miaoling.
She ignored everyone's gazes and slowly raised her delicate hands.
